metadata.er-tech-spec: title: Looply · 地址库管理 实体关系图 version: v1.0 · 2026-05-07 tables: - name: address comment: 用户地址 note: 核心实体，存储用户所有地址数据 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 UUID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user_id comment: 关联用户 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: label comment: 地址标签(Home/Office) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: ISO 3166-1 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: recipient_name comment: 收件人姓名 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: phone_country comment: 电话区号(+1) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: phone_number comment: 电话号码 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: address_line1 comment: 地址行1(街道) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: address_line2 comment: 地址行2(公寓) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: city comment: 城市 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: state_province comment: 州/省 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: postal_code comment: 邮政编码 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: district comment: 区/町(亚洲地址) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: building_name comment: 建筑名称(日本) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_default comment: 是否默认地址 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: address_type comment: 类型(shipping/billing/return) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: verified comment: 是否已验证 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: verified_at comment: 验证时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: latitude comment: 纬度 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: longitude comment: 经度 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: place_id comment: Google Place ID constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: raw_input comment: 用户原始输入(JSON) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_config comment: 国家地址配置 note: 定义各国地址字段的必填/选填规则和展示顺序 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_name comment: 字段名 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: required comment: 是否必填 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: display_order comment: 展示顺序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: display_label comment: 展示标签(多语言key) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: placeholder comment: 占位提示文案 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否启用 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: validation_rule comment: 校验规则 note: 各国各字段的格式校验正则和错误提示 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: field_name comment: 校验字段 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rule_type comment: 规则类型(regex/range/enum) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rule_value comment: 规则值(正则表达式等) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: error_message_key comment: 错误提示(i18n key) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: priority comment: 优先级 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否启用 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: address_division comment: 行政区划层级 note: 各国行政区划树形数据(州/市/区)，支撑下拉选择和合理性校验 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 UUID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: parent_id comment: 父级ID(自引用) constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: level comment: 层级(1=州/省 2=市 3=区/町) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: code comment: 行政区划代码(ISO 3166-2) constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name comment: 官方名称(英文) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name_local comment: 本地语言名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: abbreviation comment: 缩写(CA/NY/TX) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: zip_prefix comment: ZIP前缀范围(前端即时校验) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否启用 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 排序权重 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 数据更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: postal_code_mapping comment: 邮编映射表 note: 邮编→城市/州反查，支持合理性建议 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country_code comment: 国家代码 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: postal_code comment: 邮政编码 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: city comment: 城市 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: state_province comment: 州/省 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: zip_range_start comment: ZIP范围起始 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: zip_range_end comment: ZIP范围结束 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 数据更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: address_audit_log comment: 地址审计日志 note: 记录所有地址修改操作，保留1年 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: address_id comment: 地址ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: modified_by comment: 修改人ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: modifier_type comment: 修改方类型(user/system/service) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: action comment: 操作(create/update/delete) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: changes comment: 字段变更diff(JSON) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: request_context comment: 业务上下文(工单号/订单号) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ip_address comment: IP地址 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 操作时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user comment: 用户(外部) note: 用户模块提供，地址库引用user_id columns: - name: id comment: 用户ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: email comment: 邮箱 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 账户状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: country comment: 国家(外部) note: MARKET模块提供，地址库引用country_code columns: - name: code comment: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name comment: 国家名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: phone_prefix comment: 电话区号 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: enabled comment: 是否启用 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: user to: address type: 1:N label: 拥有多个地址 color: '#1565C0' penwidth: 1.8 - from: country to: address type: 1:N label: 地址所属国家 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: country_config type: 1:N label: 国家字段配置 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: validation_rule type: 1:N label: 国家校验规则 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: postal_code_mapping type: 1:N label: 邮编数据 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: country to: address_division type: 1:N label: 行政区划数据 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: address_division to: address_division type: 1:N label: 父子层级(自引用) color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed - from: address to: address_audit_log type: 1:N label: 修改记录 color: '#388E3C' penwidth: 1.4 design_rules: soft_delete: 地址数据支持软删除(CCPA/GDPR要求可彻底删除) encryption: phone_number, recipient_name 字段 AES-256 加密存储 place_id_dedup: 通过 place_id 做地址去重，相似度>85%提示用户 audit_retention: 审计日志保留1年，过期自动归档 postal_cache: 邮编映射数据 Redis 缓存 TTL 7天，月度全量同步 division_cache: 行政区划数据应用启动时加载到本地缓存，变更时热更新 address_type_enum: 'address_type 枚举值: shipping, billing, return' modifier_type_enum: 'modifier_type 枚举值: user, system, service' action_enum: 'action 枚举值: create, update, delete'
